<module id="div_8bit">
    <description>Implement a simplified radix-2 divider on 8-bit signed or unsigned integers. and the inputs are two 8-bit operands. The module accepts a dividend and a divisor as inputs and provides a 16-bit result containing both the quotient and the remainder. The design supports both signed and unsigned division operations.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">1-bit indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">1-bit indicates that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <input id="res_ready">1-bit indicates that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit the output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="DIVIDEND" type="integer">The dividend input.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVISOR" type="integer">The divisor input.</parameter>
        <parameter id="RESULT" type="integer">The result output.</parameter>
        <parameter id="COUNTER" type="integer">A counter for iterations.</parameter>
        <parameter id="NEG_DIVISOR" type="integer">Negative value of the divisor.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SHIFT_REGISTER" type="integer">Shift register for storing partial results.</parameter>
        <parameter id="TEMP_RESULT" type="integer">Temporary variable for calculations.</parameter>
        <parameter id="CARRY_OUT" type="integer">Carry-out signal from subtraction.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SELECTED_RESULT" type="integer">Selected result from MUX.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <reg id="DIVIDEND" type="integer">The dividend input.</reg>
        <reg id="DIVISOR" type="integer">The divisor input.</reg>
        <reg id="RESULT" type="integer">The result output.</reg>
        <reg id="COUNTER" type="integer">A counter for iterations.</reg>
        <reg id="NEG_DIVISOR" type="integer">Negative value of the divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="SHIFT_REGISTER" type="integer">Shift register for storing partial results.</reg>
        <reg id="TEMP_RESULT" type="integer">Temporary variable for calculations.</reg>
        <reg id="CARRY_OUT" type="integer">Carry-out signal from subtraction.</reg>
        <reg id="SELECTED_RESULT" type="integer">Selected result from MUX.</reg>
        
        <wire id="DIVIDEND" type="integer">The dividend input.</wire>
        <wire id="DIVISOR" type="integer">The divisor input.</wire>
        <wire id="RESULT" type="integer">The result output.</wire>
        <wire id="COUNTER" type="integer">A counter for iterations.</wire>
        <wire id="NEG_DIVISOR" type="integer">Negative value of the divisor.</wire>
        <wire id="SHIFT_REGISTER" type="integer">Shift register for storing partial results.</wire>
        <wire id="TEMP_RESULT" type="integer">Temporary variable for calculations.</wire>
        <wire id="CARRY_OUT" type="integer">Carry-out signal from subtraction.</wire>
        <wire id="SELECTED_RESULT" type="integer">Selected result from MUX.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Internal signals
        reg [7:0] dividend;
        reg [7:0] divisor;
        reg [15:0] result;
        reg [3:0] cnt;
        reg [3:0] start_cnt;
        reg [15:0] SR;
        reg [7:0] NEG_DIVISOR;
        reg [7:0] temp_result;
        reg [7:0] selected_result;
        reg [7:0] CARRY_OUT;
        reg [7:0] SHIFT_REGISTER;
        // Sequential logic block
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                cnt <= 0;
                start_cnt <= 0;
            end else if (opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
                dividend <= dividend;
                divisor <= divisor;
                result <= {8'h00, dividend};
                cnt <= 1;
                start_cnt <= 1;
            end else if (start_cnt) begin
                if (cnt[3]) begin
                    cnt <= 0;
                    start_cnt <= 0;
                    result <= {SR[15:8], SR[7:0]};
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    case ({CARRY_OUT})
                        8'd0: begin
                            selected_result = SR[15:8];
                            CARRY_OUT = 0;
                        end
                        default: begin
                            selected_result = SR[15:8] - 1;
                            CARRY_OUT = 1;
                        end
                    endcase
                    SHIFT_REGISTER = {selected_result, SR[7:1]};
                    SR <= {SHIFT_REGISTER, SR[0]};
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic block
        always @(*) begin
            if (!rst) begin
                res_valid = 0;
            end else if (cnt == 8) begin
                res_valid = 1;
            end else if (res_valid & res_ready) begin
                res_valid = 0;
            end else begin
                res_valid = res_valid;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
